description:
Title: New Application for Registering for an USI course

If you want to register for a course at the sports institute, you need to select a course.
If slots are free, the system tells you the courses, and dates.
Select one.
Next, you need to check if you already have an account at the sports institute.
If not, you need to check whether you are registered at an eligible university.
If you are, register your account.
If you are not, request an activation and wait for a response.
As soon as you have an account, log into it.
The application is also connected to your twitter account, and lets you tweet to friends who might want to join you, you can complete the registration for the course and provide the payment information.
In the end, you will receive a course ticket.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_USI_CourseRegistration" targetNamespace="http://www.sportsinstitute.example/bpmn/usi-course-registration">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_USI_CourseRegistration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Registration" name="Registration for course wanted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectCourse</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select course">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectCourse</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectCourse_SlotCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Slots_Split" name="Slots free?" default="Flow_Slots_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectCourse_SlotCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Slots_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Slots_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCoursesDates" name="Show courses and dates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Slots_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShowCourses_SelectDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoSlots" name="No free slots">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Slots_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourseDate" name="Select one course and date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShowCourses_SelectDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectDate_AccountCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Account_Split" name="Already has account?" default="Flow_NoAccount_EligibilityCheck">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectDate_AccountCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAccount_EligibilityCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Eligibility_Split" name="Registered at eligible university?" default="Flow_NotEligible_RequestActivation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAccount_EligibilityCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Eligible_RegisterAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotEligible_RequestActivation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Eligible_RegisterAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterAccount_AccountMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotEligible_RequestActivation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestActivation_WaitResponse</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestActivation_WaitResponse</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ActivationResponse_AccountMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ActivationResponse" messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Account_Merge" name="Account available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterAccount_AccountMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ActivationResponse_AccountMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountMerge_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log into account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountMerge_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_Tweet</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends via Twitter account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_Tweet</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Tweet_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Tweet_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompleteRegistration_Payment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePayment" name="Provide payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompleteRegistration_Payment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_IssueTicket</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueTicket" name="Issue course ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_IssueTicket</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IssueTicket_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TicketReceived" name="Course ticket received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IssueTicket_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectCourse" sourceRef="StartEvent_Registration" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectCourse_SlotCheck" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Gateway_Slots_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Slots_Yes" name="Slots free" sourceRef="Gateway_Slots_Split" targetRef="Task_ShowCoursesDates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${slotsAvailable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Slots_No" name="No slots" sourceRef="Gateway_Slots_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowCourses_SelectDate" sourceRef="Task_ShowCoursesDates" targetRef="Task_SelectCourseDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectDate_AccountCheck" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourseDate" targetRef="Gateway_Account_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccount" name="Has account" sourceRef="Gateway_Account_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Account_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasAccount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount_EligibilityCheck" name="No account" sourceRef="Gateway_Account_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Eligibility_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Eligible_RegisterAccount" name="Eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_Eligibility_Split" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${eligibleUniversity}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible_RequestActivation" name="Not eligible" sourceRef="Gateway_Eligibility_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterAccount_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Account_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestActivation_WaitResponse" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActivationResponse_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Event_ActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_Account_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_Account_Merge" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_Tweet" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet_CompleteRegistration" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteRegistration_Payment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_IssueTicket" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePayment" targetRef="Task_IssueTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueTicket_End" sourceRef="Task_IssueTicket" targetRef="EndEvent_TicketReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
